notes: Enumerated 37 mvuk repository metadata records and read selected relevant READMEs; this is not an audit of every repository.
The legacy mvuk/cdk-bark-payment-procssor README describes an unfinished template. Use the current upstream crates/bark contract instead.
Filecoin integration source from prior work was not recovered. Export is implemented; storage assurance is not.
Rolling is interpreted as Ark VTXO refresh/rollover. Proofs inform automation without removing timelocks.
No executable code was copied from the upstream projects; the PAY1 parser independently implements the inspected public binary contract.
